arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Poison or Cold {c_important}Imbued{/c} Skills have up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} chance to deploy a {c_important}Poison Trap{/c} while it is equipped, depending on your equipped {c_important}Poison Trap's{/c} element.

{c_important}Poison Trap{/c} gains the {c_important}Infiltrator{/c} Variant for free and deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
